title: GPT Live S2S
description: Shortcut for 'llm' with vendor automatically set to 'gptlive'. Connects the caller to OpenAI's GPT Live API (limited-access alpha, e.g. model gpt-live-1-boulder-alpha) for real-time speech-to-speech voice conversation. This is a different wire protocol from the OpenAI Realtime API used by 'openai_s2s': llmOptions takes only a session_update (there is no response_create — the model starts and drives the conversation itself), and work the model wants done arrives as a delegation. Set session_update.delegation.type to 'client' to be asked for free-form text context (answer with a delegation.context.append via llm:update), or to 'responses' to run a Responses API turn that can make function calls (answer with delegation.function_call_output.create). A 'responses' delegation carries a required nested object, delegation.responses, whose 'model' is mandatory and whose 'tools' take the flat Responses function shape. Tool support — mcpServers, handoff and hangup — requires delegation.type 'responses' with delegation.responses.model set. auth takes the OpenAI apiKey; the model is carried in the connection URL, so do not set session_update.model.

vendor.description: The LLM vendor (always 'gptlive' for this shortcut).

apiKey.description: The OpenAI API key. Required — the session cannot be authenticated without it.

session_update.description: Startup configuration, sent as the first session.update client event. Required: the server withholds session.started — and therefore caller audio — until it arrives.

model.description: Not allowed: the model travels in the connection URL. Set the verb's top-level 'model' property instead.

delegation.description: How the model delegates work it cannot do itself. Replacing this mid-call requires the complete object.

type.description: 'client' asks the application for free-form text context; 'responses' runs a Responses API turn that can make function calls. Tools — mcpServers, handoff, hangup — require 'responses'.

responses.description: Configuration for a Responses-targeted delegation. Required when type is 'responses'.

model.description: The Responses-side model the delegated turns run on (e.g. gpt-5.5). Required by the server, and distinct from the GPT Live voice model in the connection URL.

tools.description: Function tools in the flat Responses shape: {type:'function', name, description, parameters}. jambonz prepends the injected handoff/hangup/MCP tools here.

session_update.instructions: You are a helpful voice assistant. Be concise.
You are a helpful voice assistant. Be concise.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city
